raw: Looking at the picture: crypto just went through a bruising four days (BTC -2.5%, -1.5%, -5.0%) as the AI-driven stock selloff spilled over, but today brought the first real breath — the average coin is up +1.3%, Bitcoin has gone flat around $60k, and the hour-by-hour tape shows most coins ticking up rather than sliding. The panic looks like it's pausing, maybe bottoming. With the stock market shut until Monday and the rule saying all ten slots stay filled, the sensible move is to deploy the full $1,000 into coins now, $100 a slot, and keep the stock side in mind for a later rotation — tech fell far harder than crypto did (NVDA -14%, tech sector -6%), so beaten-down quality stocks are the natural place to rotate into once some coin climbs above break-even. /  / Since the whole game is "buy what has fallen more than average, then wait for recovery," I checked the average coin: roughly -6% since 18 Nov. So I want my picks at or below that line, with a preference for ones that have stopped falling rather than ones still in freefall. I'm avoiding two traps: coins still crashing today (M35491 at -10% on the day is a falling knife) and coins that already mooned (BTW39158 +56%, PIEVERSE +58% — they have the most air underneath them, and buying strength is the opposite of this system's edge). /  / The plan: four liquid anchors — BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB — all down about average (-5% to -7.5%), which shouldn't fall much further and anchor the portfolio. Then six beaten-down names spread across narratives so no single story kills two slots: NEAR (-15%, already green on the day), APT (-16%, rising again intraday), WLD (-13.5%, stabilizing), RENDER (-10%, +2.4% today, AI narrative turning first), LTC (-11%, payments, different profile), and INJ (-18%, the deepest fall of the bunch — riskiest slot, but its hour tape has turned positive and $100 of risk is acceptable for the largest rebound potential). That gives $400 in stability and $600 in recovery bets, every name liquid, every name below the average fall. /  / Doing nothing is not an option here — ten empty slots with cash idle over a weekend violates the whole setup. Costs are trivial (0.05% per buy), and the golden rule protects me from panic-selling anything that dips below cost afterward. /  / NOTE: Deployed $100/slot; anchors BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB + six below-average fallers.
